sourceSummary: Rochdale current 2026/27 identity selection cross-checked against the committed FootballSquads roster/DOB source, Rochdale AFC's current first-team and signing records, and detailed current or last-published role/value evidence. Snapshot-date birthdays are normalized, broad identity groups are refined to SWOS roles, and unavailable published values are encoded as 0 rather than estimated.
